children: may retest resistance at $4,503 per ounce, a break above which could open the way toward the $4,537-$4,547 range.
The metal has briefly pierced above a resistance at $4,489, the 50% retracement of the downtrend from $4,696 to $4,281. Chances are it may extend gains to the 61.8% level of $4,537.

A projection analysis on the uptrend from $4,362 indicates an extension of the trend toward the $4,520-$4,547 range, as the trend did not reverse around $4,476, the 100% projection level of a wave c from $4,362.
Support is at $4,461, a break below which could trigger a drop to the $4,433-$4,449 range. On the daily chart, the metal may test a resistance at $4,529.
A break would open the way toward $4,666, while a failure could be followed by a resumption of the downtrend from $4,696, as the rise from $4,282 is classified as a bounce.
